title: Upload Retail Admin users for your stores
summary: Create Staff and Store_Manager accounts for every store by uploading a CSV under Company Settings → Retail Admin Set-up, then share the login link.
bodyMd:
Store managers and staff sign in to the Retail Admin site (the staff tablet) with accounts you upload as a CSV file. One upload creates the accounts for every store and sets the password each person uses the first time they sign in. Allow about 15 minutes plus the time to fill in the spreadsheet.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.
  • Every store already added to the platform with a unique Store Code — see Step 6 — Add your stores from Google Places. The store code is what links each user to their store.
  • If you plan to roll out to a significant number of stores, consider single sign-on (SAML) for store staff first, so accounts are created automatically.

Prepare the CSV file


Upload the users


A row whose store code does not match a store in the platform cannot be linked to that store. Check the codes before you upload.

Verify it worked

Under Stores / Branches, the 'Last Login' column will show the date & time will show for each Store when a retail staff member has logged in successfully.

Next step

Sign in to the Retail Admin site (no SAML/SSO)
